units: <cite ref="Sanhedrin 3b:16">Snh. 3ᵇ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Numbers 35:24">Num. XXXV, 24</cite> sq.) <he>משעת שְׁפִיטַת העדה</he> from the time that the assembly meets for judging (from the beginning of the legal proceedings, the court consists of twenty-three).
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 14">Num. R. s. 14<sup>9</sup></cite> <he>על שפיטת שמשון</he> the verse (<cite ref="Genesis 49:16">Gen. XLIX, 16</cite>) refers to Samson’s judgeship.
